known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Persuasion attempts are counted per product: early band 1, late band 2; a flat refusal or non-answer uses one; do not repeat a refused offer; when used up, note refused for that product. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Ask 'Can you pay all of them today?' only once; do not ask about today again for each product. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): The floor after 'too much' is offered once; below-floor amount gets one floor offer; refusal of floor or of deadline counts as flat refusal. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Customer-proposed amounts are accepted only from the floor up to the full past-due amount, both included. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): 'Next <weekday>' is that weekday in the following calendar week; 'this <weekday>' is in the current week; weekend/holiday not after deadline is moved to the next business day. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): A date of birth given only as numbers is read day, month, year and sent as YYYY-MM-DD. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Identity confirmation: ask at most twice (a customer question answered first does not reset the count); then close not_reached/unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Declining security questions: explain once; second refusal or second 'what is this about' closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Three wrong security answers in total across both questions end the check; day_month_swapped retries do not count. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help; transfer to general only if they insist. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Customer says twice they do not want to talk: close no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Changes at read-back invalidate confirmation; re-check against dates/amount rules and read back again. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Hardship: one sentence of sympathy, no persuasion; offer support transfer; takes precedence over rules 30 and 41; a self-named date/amount is still recorded. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): On restructuring request, do not record promises agreed but not yet recorded; no notes on any transfer. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage closing): Without a recorded promise, close reason is that of the first product in get_account order whose note is not 'paid'; 'paid' only if every product noted paid. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
